title: NativeCertificationArtifact
description: Native agent certification artifact stored under .wavemill/native-agent-certifications/<provider>/<model>/<suite-version>.json

phase.description: The certified phase level; ordering is read-only < patch < workflow

suiteVersion.description: Suite version string matching the storage path segment

certifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when certification was completed

expiresAt.description: Optional explicit expiry datetime; takes precedence over derived TTL

scenarios.description: Per-scenario results from the certification run

knownLimitations.description: Optional known limitations or caveats for this certification

totalRetryCount.description: Total retry count across all scenarios

scenarioId.description: Stable scenario identifier within the suite

retryCount.description: Number of attempts made before final result
